intro: The Tome of Divinity is a pivotal paladin trial centered on uncovering a covert Dark Iron infiltration in Dun Morogh. Aspiring paladins come to the aid of injured scouts Narm Faulk and Muiredon Battleforge, securing vital enemy orders to convince the skeptical council in Ironforge of the danger looming nearby.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Before I fell in battle, Muiredon and I had almost defeated one of the Dark Iron spies near that small house. We witnessed their captain passing orders to them, and sought to kill him and take the orders.

Some of the council in Ironforge do not yet believe the presence of Dark Iron dwarves exists in Dun Morogh. By attaining one of those scripts, we'll not only have proof of their movements, but possibly an idea of what they're planning.
Get one of those scripts and take it back to Muiredon, friend.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yer back! I'm glad to see it, friend. My wounds are healed and I'm about ready to return to Helm's Bed lake as soon as I c'n convince me wife that I'll be fine.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Haha! You've done it! Ya saved Narm, and ya found the proof me wife needs to take to the council. Yer a blessin' o' the Light if I ever saw one... Not includin' me wife o' course.
